items.title: The Hidden Cost of Disconnected Hotel Operations
items.snippet: Fragmented hotel tech forces staff to manually bridge system gaps, creating a hidden labor cost that connected platforms like FCS1 claim can cut task response times by up to 40%.

items.title: Hotel Operis debuts in Charleston
items.snippet: Guests went to sleep at Grand Bohemian Charleston on September 30 and woke up at Hotel Operis the following day. Beginning October 1, 2026, the 50-room boutique property in Charleston ‘s Historic District adopted the Hotel Operis name. The hotel remains part of Marriott ‘s Autograph Collection while introducing updated branding, redesigned spaces and new guest experiences.

items.title: Gulf Hotel Deals Stall as U.S.-Iran War Scrambles Valuations
items.snippet: Skift Take: There's no evidence of distressed sales in the Gulf hotel market. But the war clearly changed the math buyers need to close deals. The U.S.-Iran war hasn’t forced Gulf hotel owners to sell. But it has stalled deals as buyers and sellers can’t agree on price now that pre-war valuations no longer hold.

items.title: India tourism faces 11 million worker shortfall: CBRE Report
items.snippet: India’s expanding tourism industry could face a workforce shortage of around 11 million workers by 2035, as demand for trained professionals struggles to keep pace with the growth of hotels and emerging tourism segments, according to a September 2026 report by CBRE Research.

items.title: New travel industry coalition calls for EU digital omnibus to enable secure, seamless biometric journey
items.snippet: ACI EUROPE, Amadeus, IATA, IDEMIA Public Security and SITA today announced the formation of the Responsible Biometrics Travel Industry Coalition, calling on EU policymakers to ensure the Digital Omnibus actively supports the voluntary and secure use of biometrics in travel while protecting passenger choice and privacy.

items.title: Ramee Group of Hotels targets 100 properties by 2032, eyes management contracts across India, GCC
items.snippet: Ramee Group of Hotels is accelerating its India expansion, targeting 100 properties by 2032 after growing from nine to 25 hotels since 2022. Senior vice president Saurabh Gahoi says the group is prioritising management contracts over lease or revenue-share models, leveraging its F&B strength and improving direct distribution.

items.title: How new T3 pier will boost IGI's international capacity by over 50%
items.snippet: Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi is planning to enhance its international traffic capacity significantly. The addition of a new Pier E at Terminal 3 will increase capacity by 1.6 crore passengers annually. Modifications at Terminal 1 will also allow for a marginal rise in domestic capacity over the next few years.

items.title: 300+ objections filed against Maidstone hotel conversion plan
items.snippet: More than 300 objections have been filed against plans to convert the former Grange Moor Hotel and wedding venue in Maidstone, Kent, into a 42-unit co-living development that could accommodate around 65 people. Residents have raised concerns over parking, pressure on local infrastructure, the scale of the proposed development and its potential impact on the character of the neighbourhood.
